comment: Recognition layer 2: community sign triggers. lat/lon projected into world space via road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world units. Entries marked needs_owner_review require confirmation from the owner's lived knowledge — map data alone is not sufficient for these.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow strip of land linking the airport to Kingston — coconut trees and sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: The roundabout where the Palisadoes strip meets Windward Road — gateway into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial waterfront community on the approach into Kingston

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community east of Kingston, known for Rastafari culture

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city of Jamaica

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's commercial hub — named for a landmark cotton tree that once stood here

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in the Western Hemisphere, established 1838

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica — route bypasses the historic town centre

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gorge town at the Rio Cobre river — home of the famous Flat Bridge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St. Catherine — famous for jerk pork and the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Community on the Linstead–Moneague road in St. Catherine

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country crossroads in St. Ann — junction to the north coast

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hillside community on the mountain climb toward Faith's Pen

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop stop — jerk chicken, festival, roast yam at the mountain summit

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Community above Fern Gully on the descent to Ocho Rios

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 3 km of dense tropical canopy — a natural wonder on the descent into Ocho Rios

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Resort town on Jamaica's north coast — end of the Airport Run
